user.title: Select LYWSD02 device
user.description: This integration reads temperature/humidity/battery over GATT and can sync the E-Ink clock. Core Xiaomi BLE usually cannot provide climate values for this model (MiBeacon object_include=0).

data_description.scan_interval: How often to connect and read climate over GATT when climate sensors are enabled. Default 30 minutes (CR2032). Range 2–60 minutes.
data_description.climate_sensors: Off by default (clock-only). When on, creates climate entities and starts periodic GATT polling. Sensors become available after the first successful reading.
data_description.retry_count: Number of connection attempts before failing a write.
data_description.auto_sync: How often to write the Home Assistant clock to the device. Automatic derives the interval from the drift measured between syncs, so an accurate clock stretches to months and a sloppy one syncs more often. The schedule is stored, so it survives a Home Assistant restart.
data_description.auto_sync_tolerance: Sets the adaptive interval (this error divided by the observed drift per day, clamped to 1–180 days). It is also the threshold for the drift check: when climate polling is on, every poll reads the clock on the connection it already opened and syncs on the spot if the error is larger than this.

sync_time.name: Sync time
sync_time.description: Write the current time to the E-Ink clock.

timezone_offset.name: Timezone offset (hours)
timezone_offset.description: Optional UTC offset in hours (-12 to 14). Defaults to the Home Assistant timezone.

read_state.name: Read state
read_state.description: Connect once and refresh display units from the device.

dump_gatt.name: Dump GATT
dump_gatt.description: Connect once (including via Bluetooth proxy) and return the GATT service tree with readable characteristic values as hex. For protocol verification in Developer Tools.

no_connectable_scanner.title: No connectable Bluetooth scanner
no_connectable_scanner.description:
Xiaomi LYWSD needs a connectable Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with `active: true` to poll climate and write time/units.

```yaml
esp32_ble_tracker:
bluetooth_proxy:
  active: true
```

proxy_not_active.title: Bluetooth proxy is not active
proxy_not_active.description:
The device is visible only via a non-connectable scanner. Enable active connections on the ESPHome Bluetooth proxy:

```yaml
esp32_ble_tracker:
bluetooth_proxy:
  active: true
```
